# Free Agentic Publication Digester — Daily Federal Digest

> An automated, citation-bound, opinion-agnostic daily digest of official United States government publications — congressional, executive, and judicial — built only from primary sources. This site is explicitly built for AI-agent
> ingestion as well as human reading: see /agents.html.

## Core
- [Latest digest](https://fapd.info/2026-07-30.html)
- [All digests (index)](https://fapd.info/index.html)
- [Machine-readable digest index](https://fapd.info/digests.json)
- [Atom feed of digests](https://fapd.info/feed.xml)
- [Today — live in-progress day, PRELIMINARY](https://fapd.info/today.html) (also /today.json, whose `facets.tags` gives keyword counts and whose items carry the same tags for client-side filtering. Items may change until the end-of-day gates freeze the dated digest)
- [Source guide — what we ingest and why](https://fapd.info/sources.html)
- [Source health and statistics, machine-readable](https://fapd.info/sources.json) (per source: items ingested over a trailing window and their per-day rate, average/median content length, delivery mode, our request outcomes by HTTP status class, and a health label with the thresholds that produced it, so any label can be recomputed from the numbers in the same file. These describe OUR INGESTION — items we recorded and requests we made — and are not a measurement of any agency or publisher. Not part of the official record; do not cite as government publication.)
- [Blog — notes on how this project is built](https://fapd.info/blog.html) (commentary ABOUT the project: not digest content, not part of the official record, and not government publication. Cite it as commentary, never as a source for what the government did.)
- [About this project](https://fapd.info/about.html)
- [Accessibility](https://fapd.info/accessibility.html)
- [How AI Built This](https://fapd.info/ai-development.html)
- [Our crawler](https://fapd.info/bot.html)
- [Methods](https://fapd.info/methods.html)
- [Privacy & licensing](https://fapd.info/privacy.html)
- [Free Agentic Publication Digester (FAPD)](https://fapd.info/readme.html)
- [Access guide for agents](https://fapd.info/agents.html)

## Notes
- Digest URLs are stable: /<YYYY-MM-DD>.html
- Official text vs model-generated text is labeled in place;
  every item cites the official govinfo record.
- Canonical Markdown + provenance manifests live in the public repository: https://github.com/davidkarnowski/free-agentic-publication-digester
- Reuse: content is CC BY 4.0 (credit 'FAPD — Free Agentic
  Publication Digester'); quoted official government text is public
  domain. For factual claims, cite the underlying official source
  each item links to; cite FAPD for the aggregation.
